subject.title: Mountain View-Los Altos Union High School District Board, Trustee Area 3

text: I am running for reelection to ensure every student is seen, supported, and set up to succeed.

As a disabled Anglo-Burmese immigrant and parent of two, I experienced firsthand the opportunities and obstacles in education and strongly believe that all students—from our highest-achieving to those facing challenges—deserve an excellent education that prepares them for college, careers, and lifelong success.

After serving MVLA for the past four years, and this year as Board President, I would be honored to continue my focus on academic excellence and opportunities for all, connection and belonging, and a transparent, fiscally responsible Board.

During my tenure on the Board, I have ensured academic excellence for all by expanding AP access, career technical education pathways, dual enrollment, inclusive classrooms for students with disabilities, and increasing English Learners' performance. I supported connection and belonging with new student wellness programs. I strengthened transparency through regular community engagement and fiscal responsibility by delivering classrooms, gyms, and Student Services facilities on budget.
I will build on my Board experience and professional and community leadership to continue delivering results for all students and ensure MVLA remains a world-class school district.
I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: I served eight years on the Mountain View-Los Altos Governing Board, twice as Board President. I'm running to bring experienced leadership that keeps our district strong, forward-looking, and among California's finest.

On the board, I helped pass the bond that modernized our campuses, championed AVID and Middle College to open college doors for underrepresented students, and worked to close the achievement gaps—because excellence must mean excellence for all.

Mountain View has been my home for nearly 30 years. As a parent of two MVLA graduates and a former trustee, I bring both a parent's perspective and the experience to lead. As a semiconductor executive, I bring a skill our board increasingly needs: Ai is reshaping education, and I can help our district navigate it wisely. Used well, AI can support every student and free teachers to teach—but its benefits are still unproven, so our greatest investment must remain in people.
I'll prioritize strong academics, student mental health, our excellent teachers, and responsible, transparent budgeting. I'd be honored to earn your vote. Learn more at sanjay4mvla.org.

text: I have spent over 40 years working for public education locally as a volunteer, PTA leader, employee and now MVLA trustee. Elected in 2018, reelected in 2022, I am currently the longest-serving trustee, having served as clerk, vice president, then president. Experience matters. I have calmly, collaboratively and with compromise advocated for and voted to guide MVLA.

My constant priorities: excellent, equitable academics that open doors to college and careers; fiscal responsibility; continued enhancement of facilities and technologies; safe campuses; and student social and mental wellness. During my tenure, MVLA has weathered COVID-19, completed $290 million Measure E bond, installed stadium lights, made our equity statement a classroom reality, launched an ethnic studies course, added positions in wellness, communications, inclusion, and CTE, expanded alternative learning programs, and added wellness areas. Eight years have seen 3 different superintendents and all new principals.

My background includes BS/MS Purdue University, former EMT, honored software engineer, various offices with Bubb, Graham and MVHS PTAs and LAMV PTA Council, school site council, substitute teacher, and MVLA IT consultant. I continually and diligently work to provide stability and innovation at MVLA. I ask for and would be honored to have your vote. www.vonne.org
